conversation.title: Warm-up
conversation.prompt: Introduce yourself and share a few details about your everyday life.

conversation.title: Personal experience
conversation.prompt: Describe a memorable experience using simple past or present forms when appropriate.

conversation.title: Preferences
conversation.prompt: Talk about things you like, dislike, and would like to try.

conversation.title: Role-play
conversation.prompt: Create a short everyday dialogue with a partner. Take turns asking and answering questions.

conversation.title: Fluency challenge
conversation.prompt: Speak for one minute. Give examples and ask your partner one follow-up question.

practice.question: Choose the correct form: I ___ a student.
Choose the correct question word: ___ do you live?
Write one complete sentence about yourself.
practice.explanation: Open response: check word order, capitalization and punctuation.
